snippet.title: War of the Austrian Succession - Trailer [PC]
snippet.description:
Fight across Europe during the War of the Austrian Succession in a tactical wargame of dynastic conflict, continental campaigns, cavalry charges, and rebellions. Command Austrian, Prussian, French, British, Bavarian, Spanish, Sardinian, Jacobite and allied forces across 85 scenarios and 3 campaigns.

Already released on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4706640/War_of_the_Austrian_Succession/
